status_effects.explanation: The narrator is maneuvered by the duke's polite refusal and left without the confirmation he sought, though he retains ironic awareness of the performance.
The duke's casual dismissal of the Elstir paintings as unloved and readily traded away locally lowers Elstir's standing in this household's eyes.
The duke's remark places Stermaria well outside the tier of guests conceivable for the prince's highly exclusive circle.

appraisal_events.evidence: « j'ai même envie de ne pas dire du tout à Mme de Guermantes que vous m'avez parlé de cela... Non, décidément, je ne lui en dirai rien. » ... « exactement comme si j'avais été dupe de la petite comédie que m'avait jouée le duc de Guermantes »
appraisal_events.explanation: The duke declines to help confirm the narrator's invitation, dressing the refusal as solicitude for his wife's fatigue; the narrator's own aside marking this as a staged 'comédie' signals he registers the maneuver even as he complies.

appraisal_events.evidence: « un superbe tableau que j'ai acheté à mon cousin, en partie en échange des Elstir, que décidément nous n'aimions pas »
appraisal_events.explanation: The duke reports having traded away Elstir paintings he and his wife did not like in exchange for a work he prefers, a local expression of low regard for Elstir's work within the ducal household.

appraisal_events.evidence: « mais n'espérez pas l'ombre de Stermaria. Gilbert serait malade, même de votre supposition. »
appraisal_events.explanation: The duke dismisses the very possibility of a Stermaria appearing at the prince's exclusive gathering, treating the name as beneath the tier of guests admitted there.
